title: Dependent Queries
description: Learn how to chain queries that depend on each other.

data.text: **Dependent queries** (or sequential queries) are queries that depend on data from a previous query. Use the enabled option to control when they run.

data.title: Dependent Query
data.content: Query that depends on another query

data.title: enabled Option
data.text: The enabled option is key for dependent queries. Set it to false until the prerequisite data is available.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Second query waits for first to complete
data.takeaway: Dependent queries handle sequential data needs.
